aiReview.method: Direct Japanese-only translation and semantic comparison of all paragraphs, lesson fields and75 assessment prompts/options/rationales with effective readings. Prior own zh-CN glossary translations used for exact identical JA only.
aiReview.register: Respectful adult 您, stable Japanese names, Japanese vocabulary headwords/kana retained with Chinese explanations.
specificChecks: Clothing choice, permission to retrieve, buttons planned independently and retrieval/change not yet performed remain distinct.
Denture box body name vs differently colored lid ownership unknown, unopened/unmoved/unused and resident location preserved.
09:25 curtain/entrance water hazards, unknown room/water/tub checks and no escort before recheck preserved.
10:15 left thumb complaint, no inspection consent, nail/skin/pain unknown, rapid nurse report and no cutting/medicine preserved.
Face washing wish is not consent for whole-body bath/wiping; fatigue remains reported words without diagnosis.
14:20 observed choice/consent vs unstarted support,15:00 other-team shampoo plan, result unknown and Kishimoto follow-up distinct.
Missing marked comb in permitted box is not proven lost; unknown-owner comb not used, grooming unstarted.
Main infection scenario used gloves have NOT touched screen; separate later staged scenario DID touch screen edge; neither merged.
No record of hand hygiene is not proof it was not performed. Visible soil requires specified soap/running water source condition; PPE not a substitute.
Separate towel practice before cloth work keeps self-performed hands vs face-only help, blue-edged towel not found, plain towel owner unknown, waiting/no wiping.
Full vs partial dentures, temperature-difference effects vs heat illness, skin glands, oral water/posture capability and individual-plan/training conditions retained.
aiReview.languagePolish: 32 knowledge paragraphs refined into complete natural learner-facing Chinese sentences after root review. Conditional clauses, subjects, reporting recipients and scope preserved; no JA source, revision, question indices or glossary changes.

limits: AI editorial review only; no human/native/domain/device/rights/release approval.
Repeated glossary records and distinct source strings are not unique knowledge concepts, and do not establish book coverage.
No other locale input, source/master/question/shared/UI/asset edits, or commit.
All7 lesson art captions translated as source limits; no technical visual or device approval.

focusedQualifierAudit.scope: Current canonical Japanese→own zh-CN weeks01–06, including sections, all lesson fields, question prompts/options/rationales/effective runtime readings.
focusedQualifierAudit.method: Mechanical full-scope binding and lexical-risk inventory plus AI semantic review of source qualifying clauses and their Chinese sentence scope. Reviewed899distinct bilingual pairs /1191occurrences across sixweeks; repeated strings not unique knowledge. Synonyms and context checked, including full paragraphs where extraction omitted Chinese synonyms.
checkedQualifiers: Order, unknown vs absent, communication vs implementation, effective displayed reading context
